verdict.rationale: Box docs confirm shared links can be created via the API with visibility settings (e.g., 'open' shared link) [box-docs-3, box-docs-20, box-docs-24], but the evidence pack never explicitly documents setting a password, expiry date, or revoking a shared link through the API. missing for 10: explicit API documentation of password-protection, expiry-date settings, and revocation of shared links.
